given: a stock record migrated to the split batch_number and serial_number columns
when: the down path of the migration runs
then: a combined inventory_code is reconstructed from the canonical location plus the split-out batch and serial

independence.rationale: prior ACs describe the forward change; this adds the distinct outcome that the migration is reversible via the down path

architectural_notes: Infra layer: the downgrade contract of the Alembic migration (PI migration_reversible). The down path recreates inventory_code and reconstructs it from canonical location + batch_number + serial_number, then drops the split columns, mirroring the up path. Owner module: the Alembic migration's downgrade(). Data-integrity / migration-reversibility concern. Verified by a real-branch round-trip test: upgrade, downgrade, assert inventory_code is reconstituted and the schema returns to its prior shape.
